# Just-Scrape Skill for Muse

💳 Paid API required: every operation consumes ScrapeGraph AI credits — needs an SGAI_API_KEY on a paid/credit-based account.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT) by @scrapegraphai, listed here with credit to its creator. Turns Muse into a web-data operator through the just-scrape CLI: a single escalation pattern covering search (find pages, answer questions, discover sources), scrape (markdown, HTML, screenshots, branding, links, images, summaries), extract (AI-structured JSON from a known URL with a prompt and optional schema), crawl (bulk extraction of a whole site section), monitor (scheduled page-change tracking with optional webhooks), plus request-history inspection and credit checks. It enforces an economy of fetches — never re-scrape what a search already extracted, reuse crawl results, check .just-scrape/ for existing data before fetching again — and it tells you when NOT to use it: for wiring ScrapeGraph into application code, adding an API key to a project, or choosing endpoint usage in product code, skip the CLI and use the SDK/API docs directly. Discovered via skills.sh. Skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass. Honest note: this is a credit meter, not a free scraper — verify the setup with `just-scrape validate` and `just-scrape credits` before real work, and store the API key in the agent's secure vault (or .env / ~/.scrapegraphai/config.json), never in code or the install prompt. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not...
